frames.prompt: Create one finished dark fantasy game UI medallion frame, a thin round carved antique bronze ring with a double beveled rim and delicate leaf engravings, restrained elegant aged gold highlights, perfectly circular with no spikes, no symbols, no lettering. Center interior is plain near-black charcoal stone. Front orthographic view, no perspective. Exterior transparent PNG alpha background (do not paint a checkerboard). Ring occupies 88% of a square canvas. This must remain refined and readable at 90 pixels across. Blank empty center for a separate room emblem. Inspired by the circular map tokens in the reference image. Create only this individual asset, not a screen.

Create one finished blank dark fantasy game UI action button, a long low horizontal rectangular carved antique bronze frame with subtle engraved floral corner ornaments and a thin beveled gold double border. Dark nearly black charcoal stone inset, smooth unobtrusive surface for later native text. Aspect ratio 4:1. Edge occupies outer 10%, middle 80% entirely blank. Straight horizontal lines and rectangular shape that can stretch horizontally as a nine-patch. Subtle warm highlights, beautiful hand-painted finish, refined rather than jagged, no spikes. No text, letters, symbols or icons. Exterior transparent PNG alpha background, do not paint a checkerboard. Match the material language of the attached reference map but output only the individual empty button asset.

Create one finished blank rectangular dark fantasy game UI panel skin. Wide horizontal aspect ratio 4:1. Perfectly front-on antique bronze thin engraved double-line frame, delicate restrained floral ornaments in four corners. Elegant low-profile gilded trim, no thick edges or spikes. Dark near-black charcoal slightly mottled stone fills the interior, very low contrast to support native text overlay. Outer frame reaches canvas edges, no outside area. All corners right angles; straight top, bottom and side edges, suitable for nine-patch stretching. No text, no symbols, no icons, no UI screenshot. Hand-painted finished production game art. Match the aged bronze trim and charcoal material of the reference map.

alpha_correction_prompt: Remove the entire gray and white checkerboard background. This checker pattern is an error baked into the RGB file. Deliver this same emblem as an actual TRANSPARENT PNG with an alpha channel, every background pixel alpha zero, clean antialiased edges. Do not draw a checkerboard to represent transparency. Preserve the foreground artwork, shape, colors and composition exactly. No backdrop, no new illustration, no changes to the object. This file will be composited over a dark game interface.
opaque_inset_prompt: Keep the existing painted emblem exactly. Replace ALL of the gray/white checkerboard with one perfectly flat near-black background, RGB 8,8,12 (hex #08080c). This is intentionally an OPAQUE game icon tile, not a transparent image. No checkerboard, no white, no gray, no pattern, no scenery, no shadow or gradient outside the object. Keep the object's metal shading, bright outlines and details intact. Center the full emblem with 10% safe empty near-black padding. The result should be ready to sit inside a dark game medallion. Do not add a medallion or any other frame.
note: Most initial and alpha-correction images retained baked checkerboards. Production uses ImageGen's opaque charcoal inset editions, except the event emblem and medallion with real alpha. No local background-removal edit was used.
